non_goals: The reduction of the general P4 coherence to Deg3 on flat is a hand derivation with a combinatorial script check, not machine-proved.
Not a proof that semi-simplicial types are undefinable in HoTT, and not an inconsistency.

scope: Cubical Agda: the Hopf family detects surf (winding -1 by refl), so surf is not refl; on the degenerate WildSST flat (S2 at level 0, Unit above, all identities refl) the hexagon fillers form r = r, two different fillings exist (twoFillings); the condition Deg3 (the form the next coherence takes on flat, derived by hand and checked by p4_faces.py) holds for the all-refl filling and fails for the surf filling at (0,0,0,1).
